title: Kundalini Eye
description: A surreal symbolic scene featuring a hooded blue figure with a crescent moon face standing on a wooden platform beside a counter of glowing potion bottles. A large green skeletal dog with a collar stands on the counter next to scrolls. Dominating the background is a massive stylized eye with a red slit pupil and dripping blood, encircled by a golden ring and a border of running white dogs. A red sign reads 'KUNDALINI EYE SPELLS - SLOT 21'.
prompt: Surreal occult illustration showing a hooded figure with a blue crescent moon face standing on a platform, wearing an ornate robe with a chain of running white dogs. To the right a bright green skeletal dog stands on a counter filled with glowing potion bottles and scrolls. A giant stylized eye with red vertical slit pupil and dripping blood dominates the upper portion, encircled by ornate green patterns and a ring of running white dogs against a cosmic red and dark blue background.
